question.text: What is 'De-statementization' (Destatementization) in the context of mutual fund units?

answer.text: Converting mutual fund units from physical Statement of Account (SoA) form to electronic form in the demat account
Converting demat MF units back to SoA form
Generating account statements for MF investors
Consolidating multiple MF folios into one

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the workbook, De-statementization (Destatementization) is the process of converting MF units represented by a physical Statement of Account (SoA) into electronic form in the demat account. The Trap: Converting demat MF units back to SoA is the reverse process (restatementization). Generating statements or merging folios are unrelated to the De-statementization workflow. Note: The standalone term "Statementization" is not used in the checked workbook pages; the source term is De-statementization (or Destatementization).
